paite: Huai thil nung in belhbu sagih tawi angel sagihte lak a khat hong pai in kei ahong houpih a, "Hong pai in, tui tampite tung a tu kizuaknu thupi tung a vaihawmna ka hon ensak ding.
heading: Kizuaknu Leh Gamsa Muhna
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

paite: Leitung kumpipate amah toh akingai ua, huan amingaihna uain in leitung a tengte khamsak in a-om uh," achi hi.
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

paite: Ama'n Kha in gamdai ah hon pomang a; huan gamsa san-au, Pathian gensiatna min a pumdim, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei tung a numei khat tu ka mu hi.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored animal, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

paite: Huai numei in puan sandup leh puan sandang asilh a, dangka-eng leh suangmantam leh tuikepsuang in akizem hi; akhut in dangka-eng nou, thilkihhuaite leh angkawm nitna a dim atawi hi.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

paite: Huan ataltang ah, "Babilon thupi, kizuakte leh leitung a kihhuaite nu," chih min khat akigelh hi.
english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

paite: Huan huai numei, misiangthoute sisan leh Jesu martarte sisan dawnkham in ka mu hi. Huai minu ka muhtak in lamdang ka sa mahmah hi.
english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

paite: Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Bangziak a lamdang sa na hia? Huai numei leh amah pua gamsa, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, thuguk ka hon hilh ding, achi hi.
english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

paite: Huai na gamsa muh a-om khin a, huan a-om kei a; kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong paikhe ding ahi, manthatna a pai ding ahi. Huan leitung a tengte, khovel siam tung a kipan a hinna laibu a min gelhlouhte'n tua gamsa om khin a, om lou leh hong om ding ahihdan amuh chiang un lamdang asa ding uhi.
english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present. TR reads “yet is” instead of “shall be present”

paite: "Hiai ah pilna lungsim neih akul hi. Lu sagihte numei tutna tang sang sagihte ahi uhi.
english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

paite: Huan kumpipa sagihte a-om ua; nga apuk khin ua, khat a-om lel a, khat ahong tung nai kei hi. Ahong tun chiang in, hun tomchik sung a-om ding hi.
english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

paite: Huai gamsa na om khinsa, tua om lou pen kumpi giatna ahi. Amah sagihte lak a tel ahi; huan manthatna ah apai ding hi.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

paite: "Huan kii sawm na muhte, lalgam nei nai lou, kumpipa sawmte ahi ua; himahleh dakkal khat lel, huai gamsa toh amau kumpipate bang in thuneihna anei ding uhi.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

paite: Hiaite'n lungsim khat nei in, gamsa kiang ah athilhihtheihna leh athuneihna uh apia uhi.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

paite: Hiaite'n Belamnou akidoupih ding ua, Belamnou in amau azou dia, amah toupate' Toupa leh kumpipate' Kumpipa ahih ziak in; amah toh omkhawmte bel sapte, telte leh muanhuaite ahi uhi.”
english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings. They also will overcome who are with him, called and chosen and faithful.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Kizuaknu tutna tui na muhte mite leh mipite leh namte leh paute ahi uhi.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

paite: Kii sawm na muhte leh na gamsa muhte'n kizuaknu amudah ding ua, suanbei leh vuaktang asuaksak ding uhi, asa ane ding ua, amah mei in ahaltum vek ding uhi.
english: The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolate, and will make her naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

paite: Pathian thu hihkim a a-om mateng, amah deihlam ahihna ding uleh, lungsim khat aneihna ding uleh, alalgam uh gamsa kiang a apiakna ding un, Pathian in amau ah ngaihtuahna akoih hi.
english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, and to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

paite: "Huan na numei muh khopi thupi, leitung kumpipate tung a vaihawmnu ahi,” achi lai hi.
english: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
